entities.docs:
One of Mary-O's REACTIVE blocks — the ones that answer a head-bonk from below.

`kind` decides what it does:

  Power   a ?-block: pops the next rung of the wand -> lantern ladder. What comes out depends on her CURRENT form, which is Mary-O's rule and not something the level authors.
  Quasar  the pocket quasar. Any form can take one and be briefly untouchable — it is not a rung on the ladder, which is why it has its own kind rather than being the ladder's top.
  Brick   breakable masonry: a bonk from a grown body removes it.

One tile, floating at bonk height over ground she can stand on. The block's collision and art come from this entity; nothing else has to be authored for it to work.

An unknown kind is REFUSED at load rather than becoming a plain wall — a block that silently stopped being special still stops the player, so the level would look whole with one bonus quietly gone.
